# Diplomat's Pack (`equipment:diplomat-pack`)
**Categories:** [Adventuring Gear](../equipment-categories/adventuring-gear.md), [Equipment Packs](../equipment-categories/equipment-packs.md) | **Cost:** 39 gp | **Weight:** 20 lb.
**Contents:** [Chest](../equipment/chest.md), [Clothes, Fine](../equipment/clothes-fine.md), [Ink](../equipment/ink.md), 5x [Ink Pen](../equipment/ink-pen.md), [Lamp](../equipment/lamp.md), 2x [Case, Map or Scroll](../equipment/case-map-or-scroll.md), 4x [Flask](../equipment/flask.md), 4x [Oil](../equipment/oil.md), 5x [Paper](../equipment/paper.md), 5x [Parchment](../equipment/parchment.md), [Perfume](../equipment/perfume.md), [Tinderbox](../equipment/tinderbox.md)

A Diplomat's Pack contains the following items: Chest, Fine Clothes, Ink, 5 Ink Pens, Lamp, 2 Map or Scroll Cases, 4 flasks of Oil, 5 sheets of Paper, 5 sheets of Parchment, Perfume, and Tinderbox.
